plan.goal: Evaluate the UX of the 'Brewlog' mobile fixture, focusing on the data visualization hierarchy, the efficiency of the logging flow, and the responsiveness of the tab navigation.
plan.summary: The exploration will begin by validating the 'Today' dashboard's information density and readability. It will then proceed to exercise the primary '+ Log' action to test form usability and input validation. Finally, it will traverse the 'Stats' and 'Beans' tabs to verify data consistency and layout integrity across different views.
assumptions: The application is a Single Page Application (SPA) where tab clicks toggle visibility rather than navigating to new URLs.
The '+ Log' button triggers a modal or inline form expansion as suggested by the 'Log a brew' heading in the DOM summary.
Data entered in the 'Add' flow should reflect immediately in the 'Today' list and 'Stats' charts.
risk_hotspots: + Log button (ux-1): Identified as a small tap target (64x32px), risking accidental misses on mobile.
Input Forms: High count of inputs (29) suggests complex data entry; risk of poor keyboard handling or validation feedback.
Stats Visualization: Risk of chart truncation or unreadable labels on smaller viewports.

phases.title: Dashboard & Navigation Baseline
phases.objective: Validate the initial state, readability of brew cards, and stability of the bottom tab bar.
key_checks: Verify 'Today' vs 'Yesterday' section separation is visually distinct.
Check that brew cards display all key metrics (ratio, temp, score) without truncation.
Click each bottom tab (Today, Add, Stats, Beans) to ensure smooth transitions and correct active states.
exit_criteria: No layout shifts or overlapping elements observed during tab switching.

phases.title: Primary Flow: Logging a Brew
phases.objective: Test the usability of the '+ Log' interaction and the subsequent data entry form.
key_checks: Tap the '+ Log' button (ux-1) and observe the entry method (modal vs. inline).
Attempt to fill out a sample brew entry (Method, Bean, Weight, Time).
Check for input masks or helpers for numeric fields (e.g., auto-formatting time or weight).
Submit the form and verify the new entry appears at the top of the 'Today' list.
exit_criteria: Form validation errors (if any) are clearly visible and actionable.

phases.title: Data Visualization & Stats
phases.objective: Assess the clarity and utility of the aggregated data views.
key_checks: Inspect 'Score over time' and 'Method mix' visuals for label readability.
Verify that the stats reflect the data seen on the 'Today' tab (consistency check).
Check for empty states or loading indicators if applicable.
exit_criteria: Data consistency confirmed between Dashboard and Stats.

phases.title: Inventory Management (Beans)
phases.objective: Explore the 'Beans' repository and its relationship to the logging flow.
key_checks: Review the list of available beans (e.g., Brazil Fazenda Pinhal, Ethiopia Yirgacheffe).
Check if there is an 'Add Bean' function and how it integrates with the main log form.
Verify search or filter capabilities if present.
exit_criteria: Bean list is accessible and readable.
Relationship between Beans and Log form understood.

coverage_targets.pages: Full coverage of index.html states (all 4 tabs).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all 24 buttons and critical subset of the 29 inputs.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat Phase 1 and Phase 2 on mobile viewport (390px width) to specifically test the '+ Log' tap target and touch interactions.

notes: Pay close attention to the 'small_tap_target' warning on the '+ Log' button during the mobile phase.
Since this is a local fixture, network error handling may not be triggerable, but UI state handling (empty forms, invalid inputs) should still be tested.
